verdict.rationale: The only bulk-like behaviour is generating many outputs from one logo in a single step: a complete favicon/app-icon/web-manifest set, the multi-part kit (colour, lockups, board, icons, guidelines), and test sheets covering many variants. There is no evidence of applying an operation across many input items at once, such as batch-auditing or batch-exporting many SVGs. missing for 10: batch processing of multiple input logos/SVGs, documented bulk CLI or scripted operations across many items, independent corroboration.
